newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Caracas stocks yo-yo up to new record close.
newsitem.headline: Caracas stocks yo-yo up to new record close.

text.p: Caracas stocks rose, then broke, then rose again to close at a record high in volatile trade that previewed future profit-taking, traders said.
"I reckon there will probably be a major round of profit- taking soon, given last week's stellar rise," said one broker.
The bolsa's 19-share index closed ahead 0.82 percent at 7,303.67 points after rising nearly six percent last week.
Trade volume was boosted to 157 million shares by turnover of over 100 million Corimon B issue shares. The stock closed ahead 15.5 percent at 15.30 bolivars.
"Corimon definitely led the session...I'm not sure why because at that price I'd unwind my position," said one broker.
Among traded issues, 20 rose, 16 fell and five closed flat. Merinvest's composite index, which includes telephone company CANTV, ended ahead 1.02 percent at 115.95 points.
